Erica: FYI — completed sandbox run of LangChain connector + Gateway shim. Quick readout below.
Matt: Nice, curious about perf and failures.
Erica: p95 ~120ms on small prompts, throughput looks fine. 503s on 2/20 long-flow runs. Gateway returned 503, stack trace points to KV cache miss + serialization error.
Nina: Can you copy the exact error?
Erica: ```
ERROR GatewayShard 0x4a3f2: kv_cache.deserialize failed: unexpected EOF
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/srv/gateway/runner.py", line 412, in handle_request
    cache = kv_cache.deserialize(data)
  File "/srv/gateway/kv.py", line 89, in deserialize
    raise ValueError('unexpected EOF')
ValueError: unexpected EOF
```
Aditya: Was this using the onprem image or cloud sandbox variant?
Erica: Onprem image `redwood-gateway:0.9.2` with LangChain adapter v0.27.1. Repro steps attached in thread.
deploy-bot: New build `redwood-gateway:0.9.3-rc1` pushed to sandbox registry — triggered smoke tests.
Matt: OK next steps: (1) Nina to run parity test against 0.9.3-rc1; (2) Aditya to try reproducing 503 locally with deterministic prompt set; (3) Erica to prepare failing prompt set + minimal repro in /suites/isv-gateway/docs.
Nina: I'll take parity test, aiming to finish EOD tomorrow.
Aditya: I'll try repro now and post logs.
Erica: Also, we should hold off on any joint announcement until we clear 503s and get 2 consecutive green runs. Legal needs a short brief too.
Matt: +1, keep comms here. If we hit blocker escalate to eng-platform.
Erica: Thanks — will update thread with RC test results. :thumbsup:
